ASS00136 is a specific laboratory code used in the Danish healthcare system to identify the measurement of thyrotropin, commonly known as thyroid-stimulating hormone. Within the 'Atrieflimren i Danmark' (Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark) program managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), this code is utilized to track diagnostic quality for patients being treated for atrial fibrillation [^src1]. 

Specifically, ASS00136 is listed as one of the valid laboratory codes that count as a completed TSH test for the clinical quality indicator "TSH måling" (Indicator 3) [^src1]. By registering this code, healthcare providers document that a patient's thyroid function has been properly assessed, which is a standard diagnostic requirement for atrial fibrillation workups. The code serves as a direct systemic reference for [[thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh|thyreoideastimulerende hormon (TSH)]] [^src1]. 

Because the available evidence is limited to its technical definition within this specific clinical quality database, no further claims, historical timeline events, or additional contextual details are documented in the current corpus.
